# FLX-2119: the plan names a kernel this engine does not implement

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

KERNEL-SPEC section 1: a plan records the kernel it was made with as `kernelVersion`, and `apply`, `replay`, `verify` and `ship` run and stamp the kernel the plan names, never the one a new plan would take. A kernel decides every draw and is inside `inputDigest`, so running the plan under another kernel would compute other rows and other digests and report them as the plan's. This plan hashes to itself and was written by an engine that implements a kernel this one does not. The refusal names the plan's kernel and the kernels this engine implements. Apply, verify or ship the run with an engine that implements its kernel, or run `fluxsim plan` with this one and apply the new plan, whose digests are those of the kernel it names.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2119
```
